basic_profile.bio: Avid League of Legends player hailing from Denver, Colorado. I work as a software developer for a tech startup, and my job allows me flexibility to play games during breaks. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking or cycling around the Rockies. I can't stand champions like Darius or Vayne ruining my ranked games. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially on weekdays after 7 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of League of Legends, gained through years of playing and watching e-sports. My knowledge is supplemented by my background in computer science, which I studied at the University of Colorado. I also actively engage with the community to stay updated on game mechanics and strategies.
